study type: retrospective analysis of prospectively kept data
cohort: 80 patients with FIGO stage I/II ovarian cancer treated with laparoscopic fertility-sparing surgery or radical surgery between 01/2000 and 10/2018 at participating centers.
finding: Laparoscopic fertility-sparing surgery appears to be applicable and oncologically safe for patients with early-stage ovarian cancer, with adequate fertility outcomes.
who: Patients with FIGO stage I/II ovarian cancer
